title: Limburgerhof Stirling Memorial
memorial_details: Memorial at the crash site in a rural location, Limburgerhof, Rheinland-Pfalz.
narrative: Stirling EF129 of 90 Squadron (coded XC), coded WP-Q, departed Wratting Common at 1937 on 4 September 1943 for Mannheim. The aircraft was intercepted at 4300m by Leutnant Heinz Hoppner of 6/NJG1 and shot down at 0020 on 5 September, his first claim. All seven crew were killed.
cause_of_loss: Shot down by night fighter — Lt Heinz Hoppner (6/NJG1), his 1st claim
